headline: Profit rebounds sharply year-over-year on steady revenue
summary_short: Best Buy's Q2 FY2026 revenue was $8,936M, up 1.9% y/y but down 35.3% q/q against a seasonally larger prior quarter; diluted EPS of $1.31 rose 37.9% y/y.
summary_long: Revenue of $8,936M rose 1.9% y/y but fell 35.3% q/q against a seasonally larger prior quarter. Gross profit ($2,102M, +2.6% y/y), EBIT ($389M, +66.2% y/y), and EBITDA ($583M, +31.0% y/y) all improved year-over-year despite steep sequential declines. Net income of $276M was up 36.6% y/y; diluted EPS of $1.31 gained 37.9% y/y. No cash-position figure is carried on the shard for this period.
